cohort.exclusions: All repositories outside the eight named members; forks, applications, private repositories, transitive dependencies, development/build/optional/peer requirements, nested packages, and non-default-branch history. Unsupported historical metadata remains unknown, never a reason to replace a member.
cohort.sampling_rule: Freeze the acquired default branch head. Walk its full first-parent chain in topology order; select the first commit with committer timestamp strictly before January 1 UTC of the following year. This is a retrospective branch-lineage sample, not a reconstruction of historical default branches. No eligible commit in a complete history is unavailable_history, not an empty declaration set.
cohort.selection_rule: Prospectively frozen before annual extraction: four established Pallets Python libraries and four established JavaScript server/CLI libraries, selected for small public Git histories, permissive licensing, and relevance to reusable application infrastructure. Purposeful convenience sample, not random. No substitution based on observed trends or coverage.
